name: Countdown
description: Adds a block to count the days, hours, minutes, and seconds since or until a specified event.
project_description:
Provides flexible countdown/countup timers for days, hours, minutes, and

 seconds until or since a target event. You can configure the display to show

 only days, days+hours, or full DHMS.

 
 New in 2.0.0-alpha2 : sub-modules for no-code placement:

 
 Countdown Block ( countdown_block ): add a configurable Countdown block to any region. 
 Countdown Field ( countdown_field ): attach a countdown field to content types and render it via formatters. 
 

 
 Similar Modules: 
 
 jQuery Countdown 
 jQuery Countdown Timer 
 
 
 
 Back to top 

 Version 2.0.0-alpha2 — Pluggable core with Block & Field 
 
 The 2.x branch introduces a pluggable architecture that unifies multiple

 countdown libraries and centralizes how assets are loaded (local vs CDN,

 provider selection, extensions, and theme/path conditions). Alpha2 adds

 no-code placements via Block and Field.
 

 
 Multi-library support: FlipClock, FlipDown, PQINA Tick/Flip, and the core timer. 
 Centralized asset control: local/CDN, jsDelivr or unpkg, dynamic version/path. 
 Per-library settings with live preview in the admin UI. 
 RTL-ready and accessibility-minded (labels, separators, contrast). 
 New in alpha2: countdown_block and countdown_field sub-modules for no-code usage. 
 
 
 Roadmap: polish Block/Field UX, Views integration, theme presets,

 and settings import/export.
 

 
 
 
 Heads-up: In 2.0.0-alpha2 the Block and Field sub-modules are experimental and APIs may change before stable. If you need a battle-tested option today, the stable 8.x-1.x branch remains available.
 

 
 Support

 Drupal.org.

 
 Countdown 2.0.0-alpha2 is available — try the new Block & Field!
